summary: Dream Finders Homes filed an 8-K reporting completion on October 20, 2026 of its previously announced acquisition of Beazer Homes USA via reverse triangular merger under an agreement dated August 6, 2026, with Bulldogs Merger Sub merging into Beazer, which survives as a wholly owned Dream Finders subsidiary. Each Beazer share converted into $33.50 cash; options, RSAs and performance RSAs were cashed out (performance awards at target). No premium, advisor or board recommendation disclosed in the excerpt. Watch integration risk, leverage and purchase-accounting disclosures.
